name: Fell Taint Thought Scourge
tactics: A fell taint thought scourge selects the most advantageous location for the combat. Primarily this means high cover for ranged attacks and difficult terrain to slow its ground-based foes. The thought scourge uses seeds of despair as soon as it can affect more than one or two opponents in the area of effect. It uses seeds of discord to force would-be attackers to move to attack back-rank characters, or make the attacker end its turn next to a seeds of despair target.

alignment.name: Unaligned
alignment.description:
Unaligned creatures don’t actively seek to harm others or wish them ill. But such creatures also don’t go out of their way to put themselves at risk without some hope for reward. They support law and order when doing so benefits them. They value their own freedom, without worrying too much about protecting the freedom of others.
	A few unaligned people, and most unaligned deities, aren’t undecided about alignment. Rather, they’ve chosen not to choose, either because they see the benefits of both good and evil or because they see themselves as above the concerns of morality. The Raven Queen and her devotees fall into the latter camp, believing that moral choices are irrelevant to their mission, since death comes to all creatures regardless of alignment.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Threatening Reach
traits.details: This fell taint thought scourge can make opportunity attacks against all enemies within its reach (2 squares).

hit.description: psychic damage. The target can choose to reduce the damage by 5 by dealing 2d6 damage to an ally within 5 squares
at the start of each of the target’s turns, the target deals 5 psychic damage to adjacent allies (save ends)

powers.name: Seeds of Discord
powers.trigger: when an enemy misses the thought scourge with a melee or ranged attack

hit.description: slide the target 3 squares, and the target re-rolls the triggering attack against a different target of the thought scourge’s choosing

attacks.name: Hit
attacks.targets: Targets a helpless or unconscious creature

effect.description: Targets a helpless or unconscious creature; the fell taint thought scourge loses insubstantial and its fly speed until the end of its next turn, and it makes a coup de grace against the target. If the fell taint thought scourge kills the target, it regains hit points equal to its bloodied total.
